crossRefs.note: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;
that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our…
to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved,
Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored…
What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were…
According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should…
Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in…
Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart…
For it was of Yahweh to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that…
O Yahweh, why do you make us wander from your ways, and harden our heart from your fear? Return for your servants’…
In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand…
for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps…
saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see…
and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth…

translations.web: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
translations.bsb: Therefore God has mercy on whom He wants to have mercy, and He hardens whom He wants to harden.
translations.kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
translations.asv: So then he hath mercy on whom he will, and whom he will be hardeneth.
